Keep the Markham Public Library (MPL) in your pocket! MPL Mobile makes it easy to discover titles, programs, manage your account, check branch hours, and more!

Features:
- Use the app to show your library card when checking out items in person
- Easily search MPL’s collections and save titles for later
- Place and manage your holds
- Browse new titles and discover similar titles
- Renew your checked out items
- Find upcoming programs and events
- Check library hours and locations
